item.title: : Russian Gymnastics Federation The Netherlands denies visas to three leading Russian artistic gymnasts
item.description: Russian Gymnastics Federation : ⚡️ The Netherlands denies visas to three leading Russian artistic gymnasts The Embassy of the Netherlands in Moscow has notified the visa centre that visa applications have been denied for three leading members of Russia’s women’s national gymnastics team – Angelina Melnikova, Viktoria Listunova and Anna Kalmykova . The decision prevents them from competing at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships , to be held in Rotterdam on October 17-25. The Russian Gymnastics Federation regards the Dutch authorities’ actions as a deliberate attempt to eliminate the strongest gymnasts from contention for World Championship medals and Olympic quota places. This constitutes direct discrimination against Russian athletes and a flagrant violation of the principle of equal conditions in Olympic qualification. ❗️ The Russian Gymnastics Federation intends to appeal to the International Olympic Committee ( #IOC ) and World Gymnastics , asking them to assess the situation and its implications for ensuring equal conditions in Olympic qualification. Five other athletes named in Russia’s main squad for the World Championships are also awaiting decisions on their visa applications: Lyudmila Roshchina, Milana Kayumova, Ilya Zaika, Saveliy Syedin and Mukhammadzhon Yakubov. ***
▪️
On October 9-10, 1942, the Nazis
murdered 214 children
from the Yeysk orphanage.
The children were locked inside gas vans, where carbon monoxide accumulated as the vehicles travelled
. They had no chance of survival. All were orphans with serious medical conditions.
After the Red Army
liberated the city
, the mass grave was exhumed
. The bodies of 214 murdered children were discovered. Many were holding hands. Some had walking sticks and crutches beside them, and their clothing had decayed.
📃
Lyonya Dvornikov
, then aged about 14,
miraculously escaped
. The boy, who had lost both legs, managed to crawl into a neighbouring yard and hide in a haystack. From there, he witnessed the killings. His story became the basis for the documentary play
“No Statute of Limitations. Leonid Dvornikov. On Behalf of Those Who Perished”
.
The murder of these children was deliberate.
The Nazis committed these atrocities methodically, with cold-blooded cynicism and without any military necessity.
🖋
Each year,
the National Centre for Historical Memory under the President of the Russian Federation
organises the nationwide campaign
“Childhood Destroyed. The Genocide of the Soviet People by the Nazis and Their Collaborators During the Great Patriotic War”
.

item.title: ⚡ Comment by the Permanent Mission of Russia to the EU Regarding the Further Expansion of Anti-Russian “Individual” Sanctions by the EU Council on 12 October 2026
item.description: ⚡ Comment by the Permanent Mission of Russia to the EU Regarding the Further Expansion of Anti-Russian “Individual” Sanctions by the EU Council on 12 October 2026 In its pseudo-sanctions campaign, the European Union increasingly resembles a desperate gambler who keeps raising the stakes in the hope of winning back its losses, which, from the perspective of the Eurobureaucracy, means inflicting maximum damage on Russia. While certain allies of the EU are seeking to engage in a pragmatic and constructive dialogue with Russia, Brussels is making statements about the single largest expansion of its anti-Russian restrictions . It is common knowledge where such reckless gambling usually leads – to a complete fiasco, bitter disappointment and belated, painful questions about whether it was worth playing in the first place. We are confident that all this still awaits the European Union. ☝ For our part, we reiterate that we consider the anti-Russian restrictive measures of the EU as illegitimate and unfounded . The Russian Federation does not recognise such unilateral coercive measures that circumvent the UN Charter. The attempts by Brussels to change Russia’s foreign policy through sanctions pressure are futile , as demonstrated by the decisive outcome of the parliamentary elections held in our country on 18-20 September 2026. ❗ The latest hostile actions by the European Union will receive due response from Russia.

item.title: 🗓 On October 12-15, Secretary-General of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (
item.description: 🗓 On October 12-15, Secretary-General of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations ( #ASEAN ) Kao Kim Hourn will pay a working visit to Moscow . On October 13, he will hold talks with Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov . Meetings are scheduled at the Presidential Executive Office, Russia's EMERCOM , Ministry of Science and Higher Education , Ministry of Agriculture , Ministry of Digital Development, Communications and Mass Media , and Ministry of Energy . Kao Kim Hourn is also scheduled to meet with Bakytzhan Sagintayev , Chairman of the Board of the Eurasian Economic Commission . The programme includes meetings with business representatives and experts, as well as addresses at a thematic session of the Russian Energy Week International Forum ( #REW2026 ) and the conference “Russia and ASEAN in the Asia-Pacific Region” at MGIMO University . 🌐 #ASEAN is one of the largest regional integration organisations , bringing together 11 Southeast Asian countries with a combined population of 684 million , a total GDP of $3.9 trillion and foreign trade turnover of $3.8 trillion . The Association will mark its 60th anniversary in 2027. Over the years, ASEAN has established itself as a cornerstone of the security and cooperation architecture in the Asia-Pacific region. It serves as the hub for multilateral cooperation frameworks involving leading world powers – the East Asia Summit ( #EAS ), the ASEAN Regional Forum ( #ARF ) and the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting Plus (ADMM-Plus)

key issues in the development of the fuel and energy sector

Over the years,

•
Oil Market Transformation
•

•
Investment in the Electric Power Industry
•

•
Environment and Energy Efficiency
•
The Energy of International Cooperation
•

💬
Deputy Prime Minister of the Russian Federation
Alexander Novak
:
The goal of
Russian Energy Week 2026
is to make dialogue within the industry as practical as possible.
The business programme
is structured around the key segments of the fuel and energy sector: oil and gas, electric power, renewables and technological modernisation.
The technology and industry strategy tracks have also been expanded, giving participants clear guidance for planning and implementing solutions. Particular attention will be paid to international projects and investment.
🌐

,
economic and energy development in the digital age, the “3+3” platform and energy cooperation in the South Caucasus
.
Particular attention will be paid to
#RussiaASEAN
energy cooperation
. A meeting of
the UN Economic Commission for Europe
(
#UNECE
)
working group on digitalisation in energy
will also take place.
💬
Minister of Energy of the Russian Federation
Sergey Tsivilev
:
Russian Energy Week provides a platform for developing solutions that are crucial to the industry’s operations.
I would also like to highlight
Youth Day
. It offers young professionals an opportunity to speak directly with industry leaders, put forward their ideas and explore career prospects in the fuel and energy sector.
This is the generation that will shape Russia’s energy industry in the decades ahead.
